description: Compile plain-language strategy rules into a structured rule set and a test module, flagging rules that cannot be compiled. When a strategy described in words must become a structured rule set. Do not choose this when the strategy must be executed or backtested. Example requests: Compile these trading rules into a rule set. | Turn this strategy description into structured rules. | Check whether these rules are implementable.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

indicators.description: The customer's indicators.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Available indicators, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

rules.description: The customer's rules.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. One rule per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_strategy_rule_compiler
title: Strategy rule compiler
